content: {"hypothesis": "The dumpcap.exe alert most likely reflects admin or network-troubleshooting use of Wireshark on a host showing routine ThinPrint auto-connect printer driver installation (TPAutoConnSvc writing print drivers, spoolsv updating printer registry keys), so it is probably benign; checking the parent of tpautoconnect.exe is the cheapest way to confirm its lineage.", "attack_likelihood": 0.1, "choice": 6}
